mechanisms.passive: Caster-scoped target status records, alternating skill slot, one successful HP/shield contact per cast, at most three stacks, four-second duration, round reset; finisher consumes only its own target stacks.
mechanisms.Q: One imported.bolt.void projectile, first legal enemy contact, no piercing; follows GGD skill-through-terrain rules.
mechanisms.W: Stationary radius 2.5 hit and finite one-unit knockback; 0.45-second one-hit source-specific physical/magic counter.
mechanisms.E: Prior three-input recast program is byte-identical.
mechanisms.R: Actual HP/shield contact starts three delayed physical strikes and one magic finisher; each strike and next scheduling checks same-target range, cancels on loss/death/settlement; consumes zero to three flames and opens one 1.2-second target/caster-scoped EX window.
mechanisms.EX: Three standalone or four continuation strikes, consumes completed R window once before branch; own mana/cooldown, wrong caster/target/expired/unfinished R stays standalone; final strike consumes only own flames.
